items.body_raw: אַתָּה הִמְלַכְתָּ אֹתִי תַּחַת דָּוִד אָבִי
items.answer_raw: Thou hast made me king instead of David my father.

items.body_raw: הִנֵּה פָנַי בָּעָם הַזֶּה וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֹתָם מֵעַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה
items.answer_raw: Behold my face is against this people and I will destroy them from off the face of the ground.

items.body_raw: וַיַּשְׁכֵּן אֱלֹהִים לִפְנֵי גַן עֵדֶן אֶת־הַכְּרֻבִים לִשְׁמֹר דֶּרֶךְ עֵץ הַחַיִּים
items.answer_raw: And God stationed the cherubim before the garden of Eden, to guard the way to the tree of life.

items.body_raw: נָתַן אֱלֹהִים מְאֹרוֹת בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמַיִם לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַיּוֹם וּבֵין הַלָּיְלָה
items.answer_raw: God set luminaries in the firmament of heaven, to divide the day from the night.

items.body_raw: וְאָנֹכִי הַסְתֵּר אַסְתִּיר פָּנַי בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא
items.answer_raw: And I will assuredly hide my face on that day.

items.body_raw: וְהָרָקִיעַ הָיָה מַבְדִּיל בֵּין מַיִם לָמָיִם
items.answer_raw: And the firmament permanently divided the waters from the waters.

items.body_raw: אל־תסתר את־פניך מהעם הזה
items.answer_raw: Hide not thy face from this people.

items.body_raw: וימטר יהוה על־העיר אש מן־השמים וישמד אותה מעל־פני האדמה
items.answer_raw: And Yahweh rained fire from heaven upon the city and destroyed it from off the face of the earth.

items.body_raw: There is a time to keep and a time to cast away.
items.answer_raw: יֵשׁ־עֵת לִשְׁמֹר וְעֵת לְהַשְׁלִיךְ

items.body_raw: Justify not the wicked.
items.answer_raw: אַל־תַּצְדֵּק אֶת־הָרְשָׁעִים

items.body_raw: Let me hide my face from this evil people, for they have done-corruptly (Hiph.) before me upon the earth.
items.answer_raw: אַסְתִּירָה פָנַי מִן־הָעָם הָרַע הַזֶּה כִּי הִשְׁחִיתוּ לְפָנַי עַל־הָאָרֶץ

items.body_raw: The king said, Cast his head unto us over the wall; and they cast his head unto them.
items.answer_raw: אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַשְׁלִיכוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ אֵלֵינוּ בְּעַד הַחוֹמָה וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ אֲלֵיהֶם

items.body_raw: For he will surely (inf. abs.) rain fire from heaven upon that evil city and will destroy it, and it shall not be remembered any more for ever.
items.answer_raw: כִּי הַמְטֵר יַמְטִיר עַל־הָעִיר הָרָעָה הַהִיא אֵשׁ מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהִשְׁמִיד אֹתָהּ וְלֹא תִזָּכֵר עוֹד לְעוֹלָם

items.body_raw: Reuben said, Spill not blood, cast him into this pit which (is) in the wilderness; and they stripped Joseph and cast him (into) the pit (acc., § 17. 3), and the pit (was) empty.
items.answer_raw: אָמַר רְאוּבֵן אַל־תִּשְׁפְּכוּ־דָם הַשְׁלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־הַבּוֹר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיַּפְשִׁיטוּ אֶת־יוֹסֵף וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ הַבּוֹרָה וְהַבּוֹר רֵק

items.body_raw: וַיַּסְתִּרוּ אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד וְאֶת־מֵינִקְתּוֹ מִפְּנֵי הַמַּלְכָּה
items.answer_raw: And they hid the child and his nurse from the face of the queen.

items.body_raw: הַשְׁמֵן לֵב־הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאָזְנָיו הַכְבֵּד
items.answer_raw: Make fat the heart of this people and make heavy their ears.

items.body_raw: פני יהוה ברשעים להכרית מהארץ זכרם
items.answer_raw: The face of Yahweh is against the wicked, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

items.body_raw: For all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
items.answer_raw: כִּי הִשְׁחִית כָּל־בָּשָׂר אֶת־דַּרְכּוֹ עַל־הָאָרֶץ

items.body_raw: I will cut off their bow and all their weapons of warfare.
items.answer_raw: אַכְרִית קַשְׁתָּם וְכָל־כְּלֵי מִלְחַמְתָּם

items.body_raw: In the day when I visit (of my visiting) Israel, I will destroy the altars of Bethel.
items.answer_raw: בְּיוֹם פָּקְדִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹת בֵּית־אֵל

items.body_raw: And he offered the ram of the burnt-offering.
items.answer_raw: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־אֵיל הָעוֹלָה

items.body_raw: הִנֵּה שְׁמֹעַ מִזֶּבַח טוֹב לְהַקְשִׁיב מֵחֵלֶב אֵילִים
items.answer_raw: Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
